name: vegetable-hand-flight-one
description: THE HAND ROUTE AS AN ACTUAL PRIVILEGE. Diagnostic arm for the post-implementation analysis of 2026-08-09. The rebuild's premise is that a Vegetable seat pays for flights out of its hand instead of its barn, and the measured hand-paid flight rate is 0.54 a game against 4.2 flights the Vegetable seat takes by the ordinary Deliver action. The reason is arithmetic, not taste: the printed route costs a GROW action, 1 matching card paid into the Depot's stack AND 2 more cards discarded from hand, which is 3 hand cards, against the base rule's 2 barn cards on a Deliver action. Three of the scarce resource against two of the abundant one is a surcharge, not a privilege, so the Vegetable seat sensibly uses everybody's rule and spends its Deliver actions on the sky rather than on the island - it makes 2.89 island deliveries against Wheat's 4.87, in a game where island receipts are 71% of a winning score. This cell drops aerodrome.handMoveCost from 2 to 1, so a flight costs the GROW's matching card plus one discard: two hand cards, the same count as the barn route, but taken on a GROW action and therefore leaving the Deliver action free for the island. READ THREE LINES AND NOTHING ELSE MATTERS: hand-paid flights per game (0.54 base), the Vegetable seat's island deliveries (2.89 base) and Vegetable's win rate (14.8% at n=1580, 36.4% even share). If flights rise and deliveries do not, the knob has bought the sky at the island's expense and should be reverted. This arm cannot answer the suit's real problem, which is that the deleted Farmstead coin took roughly GBP 7.50 a game out of the suit and nothing was put back; it only asks whether the suit's signature route is priced to be used at all. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
